verdict.summary: The change correctly adds a suite-level wall-clock budget to both Kani workflows, clamps individual harness runs to the remaining budget, records CUT/NOT RUN outcomes, and fails closed when any proof lacks a verdict. The manifest checker consistently validates both workflows' configured budgets against their job backstops and per-harness ceilings, with focused self-tests covering overrun, undersized, missing, and safe-backstop cases. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is evident in the diff.
